name: Uniti Group Inc.
summary: Uniti Group Inc. a digital infrastructure company in the United States. The company operates through three segments: Kinetic, Uniti Solutions, and Fiber Infrastructure. The Kinetic segment offers internet services, local and long-distance voice services, integrated voice and data services, and web conferencing products. The Uniti Solutions segment provides software solutions, including Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Unified Communications as a Service (UCaaS), OfficeSuite UC, and associated network access products and services.
